title: Guild Wars Prophecies
wikitext:
[[Image:Hall of Heroes poster.jpg|300px|thumb]]
'''Guild Wars Prophecies''' or '''Prophecies''', initially known simply as '''Guild Wars''', is the first released [[campaign]] of [[Guild Wars]]. The release date was April 28, 2005.

== System requirements ==
The minimum system requirements for playing Guild Wars Prophecies are:
*Operating System: Microsoft® Windows® XP 32-bit
*Processor: Intel® Pentium® III 1.0 GHz or equivalent
*Memory: 2 GB RAM
*Hard Disk Space: 4 GB Available HDD Space
*Video Card: ATI® Radeon® 8500 or NVIDIA® GeForce™ 3 Series Video Card with 64MB of VRAM
*Sound Card: 16-bit Sound Card
*Internet Connection: 56k Internet connection
*Keyboard and mouse

The recommended system requirements for playing Guild Wars Prophecies are:
*Operating System: Microsoft® Windows® XP
*Processor: Intel® Pentium® 4 2.0 GHz or equivalent
*Memory: 4 GB RAM
*Hard Disk Space: 4 GB Available HDD Space
*Video Card: ATI® Radeon® 9600 or NVIDIA® GeForce™ FX 5700 Series Video Card or above
*Sound Card: Sound Blaster® X-FiTM series Sound Card
*Internet Connection: Broadband
*Keyboard and mouse

== Professions ==
''Guild Wars Prophecies'' provided the players with the six [[core]] [[profession]]s that are featured in every ''Guild Wars'' installment.

'''{{W}} [[Warrior]]'''
:The Warrior is the only melee profession of the original 6 professions. The warrior's skills are designed to enhance the use of [[sword]]s, [[axe]]s, [[shield]]s and [[hammer]]s and they are able to use the most resilient [[armor]] in the game. These characters are the brute [[tank]]s, capable of taking and delivering more physical [[damage]] than the other professions.  They also have the primary attribute [[Strength]], which grants extra [[armor penetration]] when using melee skills. They also have access to [[Stance]]s which modify their abilities, and [[Shout]]s to boost the party's performance and impair groups of enemies. Warriors generally follow the god of war, [[Balthazar]].

'''{{r}}[[Ranger]]'''
:The [[bow]]-wielding profession, this profession also serves as a nature profession, with skills for bows, [[pet]]s, and environmental superiority.  Their attributes are, respectively, [[Marksmanship]], [[Beast Mastery]], and [[Wilderness Survival]].  Their primary attribute is [[Expertise]], which reduces the [[energy]] cost of attacks, skills, and certain spells.  Rangers follow the Goddess of Nature, [[Melandru]], their first pet is usually the [[Melandru's Stalker]] named after their Goddess. 

'''{{Mo}} [[Monk]]'''
:The healer profession, this profession serves as a healer, protector, and smiter. Their attributes are, respectively, [[Healing Prayers]], [[Protection Prayers]], and [[Smiting Prayers]]. Their primary attribute is [[Divine Favor]], which gives additional healing to their spells. Monks generally follow [[Dwayna]] when healing or protecting and follow [[Balthazar]] when smiting.

'''{{E}} [[Elementalist]]'''
:The Elementalist is the sorcerer profession. Elementalists may specialize in [[Air Magic|air]], [[earth Magic|earth]], [[fire Magic|fire]], or [[water magic]], allowing an elementalist to offer many different advantages.Their primary attribute is [[Energy Storage]], which gives them additional Energy. Elementalists support a god in relation to which attribute they are studying: Air Elementalists support Dwayna, Earth Elementalists support Melandru, Water Elementalists support Grenth, and Fire Elementalists support Balthazar.

'''{{N}} [[Necromancer]]'''
:The death-based profession, featuring hexes and corpse exploitation skills. The Necromancer's attributes are [[Blood Magic]], [[Death Magic]], and [[Curses]].  Their primary attribute is [[Soul Reaping]], which provides the Necromancer with additional energy from fallen foes (or allies). They follow [[Grenth]], the God of Death and Ice.

'''{{Me}} [[Mesmer]]'''
:A spellcasting profession, using skills to interfere with the opponent's energy, health, and skills. A Mesmer's magical ability is best described as magic of the mind.  Their attributes are [[Domination Magic]], [[Illusion Magic]], and [[Inspiration Magic]]. Their primary attribute is [[Fast Casting]], which increases the speed of their spell and [[signet]] casting. They follow [[Lyssa]].

== Tyria ==
[[Tyria]], the continent that ''Guild Wars Prophecies'' is based on, offers many opportunities for the player.

=== Six regions to explore ===
[[Image:Tyria unexplored map.jpg|225px|thumb|Continent of Tyria]]
[[Image:Krytan Towers concept art.jpg|225px|thumb|Concept Art]]
:'''[[Ascalon]]'''
::This once great kingdom lays in ruins after the [[Charr]] invasion.  Now the last surviving humans of this region struggle to stay alive and push back the ever-increasing Charr threat. 

:'''[[Shiverpeak Mountains]]'''
::This snowy mountain range separates Ascalon and Kryta and spans north of them as well. It is a region plagued by both vicious monsters, and an ongoing civil war between the [[Deldrimor]] Dwarves and the [[Stone Summit]] Dwarves.

:'''[[Kryta]]'''
::These beautiful grasslands and small forests are guarded by the [[White Mantle]]. However, an [[Undead]] presence lurks beneath the peaceful facade.

:'''[[Maguuma Jungle]]'''
::A thriving jungle inhabited by many creatures  and overrun by plantlife.

:'''[[Crystal Desert]]'''
::An arid desert inhabited by the ghosts of former warriors.

:'''[[Ring of Fire Islands]]'''
::A hellish chain of islands ruled by volcanoes.

== Player versus Player ==
''Guild Wars'' is as much a PvP-oriented game as it is PvE.

=== Random Arenas ===
:Random teams of four compete against each other for various objectives.

=== Heroes Ascent ===
:Teams of eight progress through several stages to battle for control of the [[Hall of Heroes]].

=== Guild Battles ===
:Two guilds stage a battle at one of the guild's hall. They tactically compete to control a flag stand and ultimately kill the opposing team's guild lord. Wins in Guild Battles are recorded for the ladder during tournament seasons.

== Access ==
Access to Guild Wars Prophecies requires a valid [[access key]] to be added to your [[account]]. Once added, select Prophecies when creating a new character to create a new Prophecies character. Existing characters from other campaigns can access Tyria via a [[Campaign Travel|special quest]]. See the [[Tyria]] article for more details.
